query:
SELECT 
  c.id,
  c.document_id,
  c.document_processing_status,
  c.status,
  c.workflow_state,
  c.pipeline_current_stage,
  c.ai_assessment_triggered,
  c.ai_assessment_completed,
  c.created_at,
  c.updated_at
FROM claims c
WHERE 
  c.document_processing_status IN ('failed', 'processing_failed', 'error')
  OR (c.document_processing_status = 'processing' AND c.updated_at < DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL 30 MINUTE))
  OR (c.ai_assessment_triggered = 1 AND c.ai_assessment_completed = 0 AND c.updated_at < DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL 30 MINUTE))
ORDER BY c.updated_at DESC
LIMIT 30;
